2609.21381.title: Knowledge-Graph-Augmented Chronos-2 for HEC-RAS Surrogate Forecasting
2609.21381.paper_summary: We investigate whether coupling a time-series foundation model to hydraulic project knowledge improves surrogate forecasting of HEC-RAS water-surface elevation (WSE). We present KG-Chronos-2, which combines a frozen Chronos-2 predictor with exact-state residual decoding, graph-conditioned historical retrieval, and input-aligned correction. We compare the method with persistence, a residual LSTM, project-conditioned recurrent GeoFNO, a hydraulic DCRNN-style model, and frozen Chronos-2. Task-specific fitting uses the 2008 simulation. Evaluation covers 64 fixed 24-hour windows from the 2011 and 2002 simulations at 4,675 cross sections in 71 reaches on a shared geometry. KG-Chronos-2 achieves event-balanced root-mean-square error 0.246970 in native WSE units. It reduces RMSE by 14.13% relative to frozen Chronos-2, 29.38% relative to the hydraulic DCRNN-style model, and 39.54% relative to recurrent GeoFNO. The 95% hierarchical-bootstrap interval for its event-balanced RMSE difference from frozen Chronos-2 is [-0.075177, -0.016317]. KG-Chronos-2 also achieves the lowest active-window and final-lead RMSE among the six completed systems. These results support coupling a frozen temporal predictor to project knowledge for warm-start HEC-RAS forecasting on the fixed benchmark.
2609.21381.paper_summary_zh: 我們調查將時間序列基礎模型與水利項目知識結合是否能改善HEC-RAS水面高度（WSE）的替代預測。<lb/>我們提出KG-Chronos-2，它結合了一個固定的Chronos-2預測器、精確狀態殘差解碼、圖形條件的歷史檢索和輸入對齊的修正。<lb/>我們將該方法與持續性、殘差LSTM、項目條件的遞歸GeoFNO、水利DCRNN風格模型和固定的Chronos-2進行比較。<lb/>特定任務的擬合使用2008年的模擬。<lb/>評估涵蓋了2011年和2002年模擬中的64個固定24小時窗口，涉及71條河段中的4,675個橫截面。<lb/>KG-Chronos-2在原生WSE單位中達到了事件平衡均方根誤差0.246970。<lb/>與固定的Chronos-2相比，它將RMSE減少了14.13%，與水利DCRNN風格模型相比減少了29.38%，與遞歸GeoFNO相比減少了39.54%。<lb/>其與固定Chronos-2的事件平衡RMSE差異的95%分層自助區間為[-0.075177, -0.016317]。<lb/>KG-Chronos-2在六個完成的系統中也達到了最低的活動窗口和最終預測RMSE。<lb/>這些結果支持將固定的時間預測器與項目知識結合，用於在固定基準上進行HEC-RAS的暖啟動預測。
